# **June Temperature Trends**

```{r}
#| label: June_Trends
#| include: true
#| echo: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

june_data <- subset(temp_data, month == "Jun")

june_model <- glm(temp_C ~ year * site_no, data = june_data)
summary(june_model)

june_avg <- june_data |>
  group_by(year, site_no) |>
  summarize(mean_temp = mean(temp_C, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(june_avg, aes(x = year, y = mean_temp, color = site_no)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Mean June Temperature by Site (2010–2023)",
       x = "Year", y = "Mean Temperature (°C)", color = "Site") +
  theme_minimal()



```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
